div.div: If the application requires identification and clearing of the accidental interrupt source, the error ID can be set to NON_CRITICAL for user defined error handling.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 193px; height: 1px; padding-top: 135px; margin-left: 277px;

div.div: The non-served interrupt error is reported to the error handler. The handler does not attempt to find and clear the source, as the intention is to do a device reset. In other words, the error ID should be configured to CRITICAL.
